name: search_photos
summary: Search the Photos library using Photos' own search (the same engine as the in-app Search field), returning matching photos and videos. The query can name scenes, objects, places, dates, people, or text Photos has indexed (e.g. "beach", "dog", "Paris", "2023") — far broader than a filename match. Returns each item's id; pass that id to get_photo or export_photo. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: query
params.description: Text to search for, exactly as you would type it into the Photos Search field (e.g. "beach", "birthday", "Paris", "receipt").

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: list_photos
summary: List photos and videos from the Photos library in the library's native order, capped at a small number. Returns each item's id, title, filename, date, favorite flag, and pixel dimensions; pass an id to get_photo for full metadata (including GPS) or to export_photo. This is a bounded preview, not the whole library — use search_photos to find specific items. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: get_photo
summary: Read one photo or video's full metadata by its id (from search_photos/list_photos): title, description, filename, date, favorite, dimensions, file size, keywords, and — unlike the bulk listings — its precise GPS location and altitude when present. GPS coordinates are sensitive; they are returned only here, never in bulk listings. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: id
params.description: The media item's id, as returned by search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

name: export_photo
summary: Export one photo or video OUT of the Photos library to a file on disk by its id (from search_photos/list_photos), so it can be opened and viewed. Writes into a fresh, empty directory (never overwriting anything) and returns the file path(s) and size; open the path to view the image. By default exports a rendered JPEG; set use_originals to export the untouched original file. This copies pixels out of the library — only ever called explicitly. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: id
params.description: The media item's id, as returned by search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: destination
params.description: Directory to export into. A fresh, uniquely-named subfolder is created inside it for this export, so nothing is ever overwritten. Supports a leading ~. Omit to export to a temporary folder.

params.name: use_originals
params.description: Export the untouched original file (true) instead of a rendered JPEG (false, the default).

name: list_albums
summary: List the user-created albums in the Photos library by name, each with its id and the number of items it holds. Pass an album name to get_album_photos. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

name: list_photo_folders
summary: List the folders in the Photos library by name (folders group albums and other folders). Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

name: get_album_photos
summary: List the photos and videos inside a named album, capped at a small number, returning each item's id and basic metadata. Use list_albums to find a valid album name. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: album
params.description: Exact name of the album to read (see list_albums).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: list_favorites
summary: List the photos and videos in the Photos Favorites album, capped at a small number, returning each item's id and basic metadata. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: list_recently_deleted
summary: List the photos and videos currently in the Photos Recently Deleted album (items pending permanent deletion, recoverable for 30 days), capped at a small number. Useful to see what is staged for deletion. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 25, maximum 100).

name: get_selection
summary: List the photos and videos currently selected in the Photos app window, returning each item's id and basic metadata — a bridge to "act on what I'm looking at". Returns nothing if Photos has no selection. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

name: library_stats
summary: Report Photos library totals: the number of media items (photos and videos), albums, and folders. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

name: set_favorite
summary: Mark a photo or video as a favorite, or remove the favorite mark, by its id (from search_photos/list_photos). STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the previous favorite state. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: id
params.description: The media item's id, as returned by search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: favorite
params.description: true to mark as a favorite, false to remove the favorite mark.

name: set_title
summary: Set (or clear) a photo or video's title by its id (from search_photos/list_photos). STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the previous title. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: id
params.description: The media item's id, as returned by search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: title
params.description: The new title. Pass an empty string to clear the title.

name: set_description
summary: Set (or clear) a photo or video's description (caption) by its id (from search_photos/list_photos). STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the previous description. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: id
params.description: The media item's id, as returned by search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: description
params.description: The new description (caption). Pass an empty string to clear it.

name: set_date
summary: Change a photo or video's date/time by its id (from search_photos/list_photos). STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the previous date. The item must already have a date (so undo can restore it). Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: id
params.description: The media item's id, as returned by search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: date
params.description: The new date in YYYY-MM-DD form (e.g. 2024-07-04).

params.name: time
params.description: The new time of day in 24-hour HH:MM form (default 00:00).

name: set_keywords
summary: Replace a photo or video's entire keyword list by its id (from search_photos/list_photos). STAGED for confirmation; undo restores the previous keywords. Pass an empty list to clear all keywords. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: id
params.description: The media item's id, as returned by search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos.

params.name: keywords
params.description: The complete new list of keywords (this REPLACES the existing keywords). Pass an empty list to remove all keywords.

name: create_album
summary: Create a new, empty album in the Photos library, optionally inside a folder. STAGED for confirmation. NO automatic undo: Photos provides no scripted album deletion, so to reverse this you must delete the album yourself in Photos (the photos themselves are never affected). Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the new album.

params.name: parent_folder
params.description: Exact name of an existing folder to create the album inside (see list_photo_folders). Omit to create it at the top level.

name: create_folder
summary: Create a new, empty folder in the Photos library, optionally inside another folder. Folders group albums and other folders. STAGED for confirmation. NO automatic undo: Photos provides no scripted folder deletion, so to reverse this you must delete the folder yourself in Photos. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the new folder.

params.name: parent_folder
params.description: Exact name of an existing folder to create the new folder inside (see list_photo_folders). Omit to create it at the top level.

name: add_to_album
summary: Add one or more existing photos/videos (by id, from search_photos/list_photos) to an existing album. This only changes album membership; it never copies or moves the underlying photo. STAGED for confirmation. NO automatic undo: Photos provides no scripted way to remove an item from an album, so to reverse this you must remove the items yourself in Photos. Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: album
params.description: Exact name of the existing album to add to (see list_albums).

params.name: ids
params.description: One or more media item ids to add (from search_photos, list_photos, or get_album_photos).

name: import_photos
summary: Import image/video files from disk into the Photos library, optionally adding them to an album. STAGED for confirmation. NO automatic undo: Photos provides no scripted way to delete imported media items, so to reverse this you must delete the imported items yourself in Photos (they then sit in Recently Deleted, recoverable for 30 days). Drives Photos via AppleScript; the first use may prompt for Automation access to Photos.

params.name: files
params.description: One or more paths to image/video files to import. Supports a leading ~.

params.name: album
params.description: Exact name of an existing album to add the imported items to (see list_albums). Omit to import without adding to an album.
